tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: Fetches the latest published articles from Скопје1.мк as structured data. Returns title, URL, summary, and publication date.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1–50, default 10)

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a specific page on Скопје1.мк. Supported paths: /vesti/ (news), /video/ (videos), /najnovi (latest), /baraj?q= (search), /oznaki/{tag} (by tag), /avtori/{user} (by author), or any article slug.

path.description: The URL path to navigate to (e.g. /vesti/, /najnovi)

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search for Macedonian news articles on Скопје1.мк by keyword or phrase. Navigates the browser to the search results page.
